rows.Col10: Update Notes:

Ka'apana suffered a severe lower-leg injury during spring drills that required surgery and shut him down for the year. The reserve tailback remains on the out-for-season list while continuing through long-term physical rehabilitation.

Hamilton sustained a season-ending lower-right-leg injury during preseason fall camp drills in late August. The freshman interior offensive lineman was placed on the out-for-season list and will focus entirely on recovery for the 2027 campaign.

Alford was placed on the initial Week 4 Big Ten availability report as out ahead of the Iowa matchup and has remained there since. The wide receiver has yet to clear return protocols and remains sidelined outside the active offensive rotation.

Holly landed on the late-September availability report as out prior to conference play and did not suit up. The edge defender remains unavailable for defensive line rotation reps pending medical clearance.

Sprague was a surprising late scratch in Week 3 and has been unable to clear return protocols since. The offensive tackle remains ruled out on weekly Big Ten reports while continuing through team evaluation.

Bell was officially ruled out on the October 17 availability update after carrying an initial doubtful designation into the game week. The wideout remains sidelined from game action as medical staff monitor his recovery trajectory.
Suspended indefinitely and likely not to return to the Wolverines.
